_comment: Public COA index. Every record here is searchable on the site. Required per record: code, company, compound. Everything else is optional and simply omitted from the result card if absent - in particular, a chromatogram is only drawn when 'rt' is present. 'file' defaults to <code>.pdf inside config.pdfBase. Regenerate from the bucket with tools/Build-CoaIndex.ps1, which preserves metadata already in this file.
